propositions: Add `caused_by` as a 7th directional link relation expressing bug causation provenance.
The `caused_by` relation must be non-blocking and non-cycle-inducing, following `discovered_from` precedent.
The hardcoded non-blocking tuple at `src/rebar/graph/_graph.py` line ~204 must include `caused_by` or it will incorrectly receive blocking-cycle semantics.
`caused_by` must be intentionally Jira-unmapped (like `discovered_from`, `duplicates`, `supersedes`) and additive to the schema enum with no persisted data migration.
Round-trip link creation with `caused_by` relation must preserve relation type in reduced graph output and reject backward-incompatible constraint violations.
Golden CLI-help snapshots across `tests/golden/cli_help/*.out` must be regenerated to enumerate the 7-relation set including `caused_by`.
